title: [3.0-beta3] Carbs in Graph are shown in orange, which is not really readable
body: In the first diagram the carbs (activities) are shown in only a orange. For my eyes this is not really readable compared to the blue colour of the Insulin actions.

comments.body: Any Suggestions ? I would like to Change Italien than in my day/Night Branch .
I had the problem too and swapped that back to the color that was used before: insulin blue. - It is a deviation from the strict color concept, but still readable.
